name: Nihongo Master v1.5.0 - The Gallery Sniper & Unified Pause Menus
changelog: v1.5.0: Added 3rd game: The Gallery Sniper (射的ギャラリー). Includes dual Kana practice modes (Hiragana & Katakana), 15 authentic vocabulary words per mode, dynamic distractor decoy targets, arcade bullseyes, mouse and analog gamepad crosshair navigation with recoil physics, and a fully featured Pause Menu modal (Resume, Restart Round, Switch Kana, Return to Title). Main Menu expanded to 6 symmetrical game cards with seamless subgame switching.
